usage: Level-up spell list for the listed classes. Combat runs it only when a wired ability has the same id.

srd.text:
_Necromancy Cantrip (Cleric, Druid)_

**Casting Time:** Action
**Range:** 15 feet
**Components:** V, S
**Duration:** Instantaneous

Choose a creature within range that has 0 Hit Points and isn't dead. The creature becomes Stable.

_Cantrip Upgrade._ The range doubles when you reach levels 5 (30 feet), 11 (60 feet), and 17 (120 feet).
